correctness.rationale: Independently re-verified every inference. Setup: pi(center)=1/(2L), pi(leaf)=1/(2kL), pi(internal)=1/(kL) normalizes to 1; J_t Markov with stated transitions (move prob 1/2 at every state) and leg-conditional description correct. Lemma 1: jump-chain equations g0=0, g_a=1+(g_{a-1}+g_{a+1})/2, g_L=1+g_{L-1} solved by g_a=a(2L-a) checked algebraically for L in {1,5,10,20}; lazy factor 2 valid because hold/move coin (prob 1/2 everywhere) independent of direction coins, so E[H]=2E[G]; max 2L^2 at leaf; L=1 gives mean 2 = Geometric(1/2), consistent. Cycle lift N=2L with fold f(z)=min(z,N-z) reproduces J transitions at 0 and L (both preimages map to same J move); L=1 N=2 flip interpretation holds. Lemma 2: alternating-selection gives each marginal stay 1/2 + each neighbor 1/4 (for N=2, stay 1/2/flip 1/2), folds faithful; difference D moves +-1 w.p. 1/2 each step with no hold, absorption mean d0(N-d0) standard and max N^2/4=L^2; Z-meet implies fold-meet so tau_J<=tau_Z, E[tau_J]<=L^2; parity/reachability holds. Lemma 3: J-level synchronous rule (common stay/move coin, common +-1 interior, 0->1 and L->L-1 together) preserves equality, has correct marginals, joint J is single J-chain with hitting mean <=2L^2 by Lemma 1; at joint 0 both at unique center so coalesced; early off-center meeting only shortens time so expectation bound safe. Strong Markov composition gives E[tau]<=L^2+2L^2=3L^2<=8kL^2. Markov restart: P(tau>T0)<=1/4 with T0=4M, induction P(tau>(m+1)T0)<=1/4 P(tau>mT0) via Markov property and uniform bound gives 4^-m<=2^-m. Coupling inequality to d(mT0)<=4^-m, t_mix(1/4)<=T0, t_mix(eps)<=T0 ceil(log2(1/eps)) via ceil(log4)<=ceil(log2) for eps<=1/2 all verified. Centered tail: t=mT0+r gives P(tau>t)<=4^-m<=2exp(-t/(64kL^2)) because T0/(64kL^2)=1/2 and 4^-m<=2e^{-(m+1)/2} holds (ratio (e^{1/2}/2)(e^{1/2}/4)^m<=0.824, decreasing); upper deviation subset, lower deviation split t>=E (prob 0) vs t<E (prob<=1<=2exp(...) since t/(64kL^2)<=3/(64k)<=1/64<ln2) gives two-sided bound with c=1/64 without extra union factor. Conductance leg A: pi(A)=(2L-1)/(2kL)<=1/2 for k>=3, Q=1/(4kL), Phi=1/(2(2L-1)), gap>=Phi^2/2=Omega(1/L^2) consistent (sanity only). Simulations are support not proof: hash 0ae11070c214b88b7edb3a3e3c2723a789200abec6d5f9fc0883cfa067bf2de0 matches, independent re-run of leaf->center (k=3,L=5,10) reproduces 2L^2 within ~1%, reported means ~2L^2 within 3L^2 envelope with 1.5x slack and zero T0 exceedances consistent with 48x slack. Minor exposition slips (Z-common-direction phrasing in Lemma 3 does not preserve equality for opposite lifts, but explicitly stated J-increment rule does and suffices; 'worst start' label for equal-distance leaves ignores Stage-1 contribution) do not invalidate any bound.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp/search-count. Nearest (1) Feng-Gerencser arXiv:2411.07125: n-cycle plus k random edges, non-reversible biased/lifted walk, asymptotic O(n^{(k+2)/(k+1)}) speedup via drift/lift; different graph family (cycle+edges vs deterministic balanced-spider tree), different reversibility (non-reversible vs reversible lazy simple), different claim (asymptotic order vs non-asymptotic k-L coupling tail + t_mix(eps)<=32kL^2 ceil(log2(1/eps))) and method (lift/drift vs gambler ruin + cycle-fold alternating coupling). Nearest (2) Csaki et al. arXiv:1501.00466: infinite spider (half-lines at origin), Brownian-spider strong approximation and excursion-height asymptotics; no finite stationary pi, no TV mixing, no concentration. Nearest (3) Dembo-Rosen-Zeitouni arXiv:1906.07276: binary tree of depth n cover time GFF limit law for sqrt(C_n 2^{-(n+1)})-m_n; different tree (binary vs starlike), observable (cover limit vs mixing tail) and method (GFF extremal vs elementary coupling). arXiv all-field search 'mixing spider walk' returns no results, confirmed by fetch. Generic Levin-Peres-Wilmer coupling inequality and gambler ruin d(N-d) used as black-box textbook tools (explicitly credited), but instance to S(k,L) with radial reduction, C_{2L} fold, two-stage mean 3L^2, geometric 4^-m tail and centered 1/64 tail is not stated in any source. No prior finite-spider mixing tail found.

value.rationale: Independently worth finding: first explicit non-asymptotic coupling-tail mixing concentration for two-parameter balanced spiders S(k,L) interpolating star (L=1) and path-like extremes, isolating central-branching vs diffusion with checkable rate. Sharper proved mean 3L^2 (independent of k) implies claimed 32kL^2 tail; far below generic tree n^3 (~1e6 at n=101 vs T0=38400 at k=3,L=20) and improves generic n^2=k^2L^2 by factor k^2/k, so not epsilon-shaving. Provides functional form (geometric tail + centered exponential + t_mix(eps) concentration) where none existed, plus seeded falsifiable envelope (mean slack ~1.5x, hitting within 1%) as MCMC benchmark on tree-structured spaces. Not a textbook restatement (textbook inequality is black box; novelty is construction + explicit constants), not mere n-rescaling ((k,L) jointly control branching, stationary and conductance verified k-independent in leading order), not tiny gain, not unexplained enumeration (proof + audit table). Limitations (upper bound only, generous constants, no cutoff/lower bound, balanced symmetry essential) are disclosed and do not erase benchmark value.
